context: Media news: Sakura and Ren on a documentary release.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: media news; broadcast vocabulary (放送/公開/登場/イメージ/男性) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 話題の番組が、来週放送されます。
lines.en: A much-talked-about program airs next week.
lines.style: bright adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一般公開は、いつからですか?
lines.en: When does the public release begin?
lines.style: curious young commentator voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 放送と同時に、公開されます。
lines.en: It's released at the same time as the broadcast.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい司会者も、登場するんですか?
lines.en: Will a new host appear too?
lines.style: engaged young commentator voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ええ、若い男性が登場します。
lines.en: Yes, a young man will appear.
lines.style: professional adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 番組のイメージも、変わりそうですね。
lines.en: The program's image seems likely to change.
lines.style: analytical young commentator voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 公開後の反応が、楽しみですね。
lines.en: I look forward to the response after release.
lines.style: warm adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 放送を、ぜひ見てみたいです。
lines.en: I really want to watch the broadcast.
lines.style: eager young commentator voice, soft warm closing throughout
